title: Register desktop connection bootstrap
responsibility: Registers the single IPC operation that supplies a trusted renderer with its local socket connection details.

inputs.name: desktopIpc.port
inputs.description: The IPC port used to register the handler and remove it during cleanup. It must implement `handle(channel, listener)` and `removeHandler(channel)`; the interface leaves both method return values unknown.

inputs.name: desktopIpc.bootstrap
inputs.description: Called with the IPC event for each `transport:bootstrap` request and returns the local bootstrap for a trusted top frame or `null` otherwise. A falsy result makes the handler reject with `Error('Untrusted renderer.')`, and callback exceptions propagate.
inputs.unknownReason: The adapter receives a runtime IPC event and delegates top-frame verification to the supplied callback.

outputs.name: bootstrapChannel
outputs.description: The one channel the main process answers over IPC: `transport:bootstrap`. It carries the bootstrap for the caller's own loopback socket; project operations and the control port use that socket.

outputs.name: desktopIpc
outputs.description: The function returns a cleanup callback after registering the handler. Calling it invokes `removeHandler(bootstrapChannel)` to remove the `transport:bootstrap` handler.

errors.name: UntrustedRendererError
errors.description: The handler throws `UntrustedRendererError('Untrusted renderer.')` when the bootstrap callback returns a falsy answer. Exceptions from the callback, `handle`, or `removeHandler` propagate from the corresponding call.
